# essentia group

> essentia is an integrated design-to-build group founded in 1999 by hardesh and monica chawla, spanning architecture, interiors, in-house manufacturing, and furniture retail through essentia environments and essentia home. based in gurugram, india, with a 100,000 sq ft manufacturing facility in manesar and 1000+ projects delivered.

## company
- [about essentia](https://essentia.in/about): 26-year story of the integrated design-to-build model.
- [founders](https://essentia.in/founders): hardesh chawla (director), monica chawla (creative head). hridik chawla co-founded essentia home.
- [manufacturing](https://essentia.in/manufacturing): 100,000 sq ft in-house facility in manesar producing furniture, wardrobes, doors, kitchens, panelling and joinery.
- [press](https://essentia.in/press): forbes india, elle decor, and other recognition.

## group sites
- [essentia environments](https://essentiaenvironments.com): full service design and build firm for turnkey residential and commercial projects.
- [essentia home](https://essentiahome.com): furniture and design-led living destination with in-house manufactured collections.
